title: C550 author successfully creates a duplicate Run directory before correcting its candidate path
observation: Turn16 has three completed successful tool calls and no pending tool: Write to actor/Run-id/candidate-set.py, Write to actor/candidate-set.py, then Edit to actor/candidate-set.py. The exact terminal declares candidate_written. Two distinct successful paths correctly fail v4's one-file lifecycle. This is not a context-compaction fault or a recovered denied write. The four-task batch is sealed; fifty tasks never started.
proposed_change: Reuse opt-in v5 denial recovery from F-2026-10-07-006. Its invocation explicitly selects restricted file tools and names the absolute candidate file on initial and resumed turns. Its parser rejects a successful nested candidate path immediately. Preserve v3/v4 argv, prompts, interpretation and original failed evidence. A new wrapper/configuration needs fresh live qualification before successor experiments.
promotion_disposition: Lab provider transport only. No Compiler change, performance promotion, retry or original outcome reclassification. Native file-tool confinement and live successor qualification remain separate acceptance requirements.
